samples.scenario: Misconfigured Google Cloud Storage bucket with uniform bucket-level access disabled, allowing allUsers role with roles/storage.objectViewer permission, resulting in unrestricted public read access and exposure of confidential project documents.

network_packet_capture: Frame 1: 74 bytes on wire (592 bits), 74 bytes captured (592 bits)

Frame 2: 1150 bytes on wire (9200 bits), 1150 bytes captured (9200 bits)

automated_scanner_output.result: Bucket 'project-confidential-data' found with public objectViewer role granted to allUsers, allowing anonymous read access to all objects.
automated_scanner_output.recommendation: Enable uniform bucket-level access to manage permissions at bucket level only and remove allUsers member from IAM roles. Restrict access to authorized service accounts and users.

indicators: IAM policy binding includes allUsers with roles/storage.objectViewer
Audit logs showing anonymous principal performing storage.objects.list
HTTP GET requests retrieving bucket object listings and sensitive PDF documents
Network captures showing unauthenticated HTTPS GET requests to GCS endpoints
Automated bucket audit tool confirming public read access
samples.detection_method: Use Google Cloud Asset Inventory and IAM Analysis to detect public bindings, enable Cloud Storage uniform bucket-level access, monitor audit logs for anonymous or unexpected access patterns, deploy periodic bucket scanning tools, and alert on public permission changes.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: Azure Blob Storage container with public access level set to 'Blob', allowing anonymous users to read blobs without authentication, exposing sensitive customer PII and internal reports downloadable via HTTP requests.

automated_scanner_output.result: Container public access level set to 'Blob', allowing anonymous read access to blobs without authentication.
automated_scanner_output.recommendation: Change container access level to 'Private' and implement Azure RBAC policies to restrict access to authorized users only. Enable storage analytics and alerts for public access.

indicators: Container access level configured as 'Blob' enabling anonymous blob read
Azure activity logs showing unauthenticated GetBlob operations
HTTP GET requests retrieving CSV files containing sensitive PII data
Network packet captures showing HTTPS GET requests from external IPs
Automated scanner identifying public container access
samples.detection_method: Leverage Azure Security Center recommendations to detect publicly accessible blob containers, monitor Azure Storage logs for anonymous blob reads, enforce Azure Policy to disable public access on storage containers, and schedule regular automated scans for misconfigurations.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
